fragment.purpose: Select one differentiated, externally grounded scientist-agent comparison unit.
unresolved: Which primary-source scientist-agent system has the strongest demonstrated and reproducible mechanism fit.
Whether any mechanism has a falsifiable expected-time advantage over O's current loop.

observations: The selected unit directly operationalizes inbox revision 12 without assuming that importing a fashionable mechanism helps O.
A fixed rubric and no-change outcome reduce novelty bias and speculative implementation risk.

result.claim_boundary: A useful baseline comparison or implementation remains internal development evidence and does not establish AGI.
evidence_needed: A source-cited mechanism map with independently demonstrated claims separated from author claims and local inference
A mechanically reproducible O-side inventory using exact paths and tests
A fixed comparison rubric covering hypothesis generation, experiment execution, evaluator independence/mechanical scoring, result inheritance, cost, and failure containment
A counterfactual expected-time argument with explicit falsifier for any proposed change
Focused regression or a no-change verdict when no advantage is established
expected_outputs: One durable machine-readable external-baseline comparison artifact
One bounded verdict: ADOPT_MINIMAL_CHANGE, EXPERIMENT_REQUIRED, or NO_CHANGE
If adopted, one small reversible implementation and focused test; otherwise exact negative evidence and a new differentiated next action
No AGI or user-level completion claim
result.goal: Compare one independently demonstrated scientist-agent closed loop against O across hypothesis generation, experiment execution, mechanical evaluation, and result inheritance; identify at most one minimal reversible O change only if the comparison yields a falsifiable expected-time advantage.
inputs: agi/WORK_STRATEGY.json and current O native Run records
primary-source paper, official repository, or official project documentation for one scientist-agent system
current O implementations for hypothesis/task selection, execution, evaluation, episode consolidation, and learned-result inheritance
result.parent_continuation: The user-level objective remains FAIL after the external-handoff cross-binding unit PASS. Continue through Candidate Evaluate, Execute, Task Evaluate, Consolidate Episode, and Learn; do not end at the comparison artifact or one test.
success_conditions: The baseline mechanism has a primary-source trace and a demonstrated result, not merely a proposal.
Every comparison cell cites either external evidence or an exact O code/test location.
Any implementation is justified by a quantitative or ordinal expected-time prediction and has a stated rollback condition.
Absence of comparative advantage produces NO_CHANGE rather than speculative code.
